Sub:- Compliance Audit of exempted establishments — reg.
Sir,

Kindly refer to Head Office circular No. C-Ex/Misc/Comp.Audit.2009/42570 —
42650 dt. 18/10/10 vide which it was directed that a comprehensive compliance audit of
all exempted establishments [u/s 17(1)(a)/Para 79 or Para 27A] shall be carried out by
report thereof to Head Office by the RPFC-I of the region in Annexure-Hl by 15/01/11.

You are therefore requested to strictly follow the time lines mentioned in the
above said circular and submit your report to Head Office latest by 15/01/11 with a soft
copy at rpfcexm @ rediffmail.com.

Further, you are also requested to furnish an action taken report in respect of
violations noticed in respect of all defaulters establishment as mentioned in the
Quarterly Report [ April, 2010 to June, 2010] forwarded by you to this office.

Yours faithfully,

(Dr. A.K. Dubey)
Regional Central P.F. Commissioner{Compliance)

Copy to:- RPFC (NDC) with a request to update the circular on the EPFO website.
